The dentist, a seasoned professional, is older than the dental hygienist. A dental hygienist is cleaning instruments in a sterilizer while standing next to a sink. The sterilizer contains two mirrors and a number of probes that is twice the number of mirrors. A receptionist is scheduling appointments while typing on a computer keyboard. The computer screen displays a calendar with appointments. A child patient is sitting in the waiting room, holding a toy while her mother fills out paperwork.
